# Detroit Fight Company

> Combat sports academy in Winter Springs, Florida, offering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (gi and no-gi), boxing, and Muay Thai for adults and kids. Founded by IBJJF black belt Sean Goolsby. Free trial class available.

## Location
1425 Tuskawilla Rd #209, Winter Springs, FL 32708. Serves Winter Springs, Oviedo, Casselberry, Seminole County, and greater Orlando.

## Programs
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: gi, no-gi, kids, women's only, open mat
- Boxing and conditioning
- Muay Thai
- Single All Access Membership, $199/month, no contracts
